title: A read-only Kimi reviewer is refused Engram MCP reads (next --peek, memories) that read-only Codex and Claude reviewers can make
outcome: A read-only Kimi reviewer can make the same read-only Engram MCP calls (startup recovery: next --peek, memories, show) that read-only Codex and Claude reviewers can, while every Engram write stays refused for all three; a Kimi stand-in for an unavailable reviewer starts with the required recovery.
acceptance: A cause note identifies, from source with file:line, why the read-only policy refuses Engram MCP read calls for a Kimi reviewer but not for Codex or Claude reviewers spawned the same way (tool-name mapping, MCP permission classification, or Kimi-specific approval path).

Tests show a read-only Kimi reviewer's Engram read calls (next --peek, memories, show) are admitted and every Engram write call (claim, note, update, done, add) is still refused, matching the Codex and Claude reviewer behaviour; existing Codex and Claude read-only controls stay green.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
